editorial:
Imagine the biggest stars from America and Japan finally stepping into the same ring to settle their scores. You get a high-energy show that feels more like a giant party than a sports event. The vibe is electric because it takes place at The O2 in London, and the crowd is absolutely wild. You will see legendary wrestlers from AEW and NJPW facing off in matches that have been teased for months. It is a wild ride filled with huge personalities, loud cheers, and a lot of physical drama that keeps you on the edge of your seat the whole time.

What really hits home is the fast pacing and the sheer skill of the athletes. The action is top-tier, though a few of the middle matches drag on a bit too long. If you love seeing dream matches come true, you cannot miss this. You should definitely watch this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch every single hit and facial expression. If you are a die-hard fan, grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection is the way to go so you can rewatch the best moments whenever you want.
endingExplained: The show ends with a massive main event that sees the top champion from AEW face off against the NJPW ace. After a long and brutal battle, a shocking betrayal happens when a teammate turns on the champion, leading to a pinfall victory for the Japanese star. The event wraps up with the new champion holding the belt high while the crowd goes crazy, leaving you wondering how the defeated wrestler will ever get their revenge.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves professional wrestling and big spectacle events.
